resources.string: Wired and Wi-Fi devices on the same LAN are supported. If discovery fails, check network access, firewalls and router device isolation.
LimLink transfers files directly within the same LAN. A computer can use Ethernet while a phone uses Wi-Fi or a hotspot. Files do not pass through a server.
Open LimLink on the same LAN. A computer can use Ethernet and a phone Wi-Fi. If discovery fails, check network access, firewalls and router isolation.
